# Test tree (design/30 section 1). Labels: unit, integration, mpi, slow, reference.

# Toolchain smoke tests: the Kokkos backend and the MPI launcher work.
add_subdirectory(smoke)

# Unit tests, one directory per module (tests/unit/<module>/), discovered like src/ modules so that
# parallel milestones do not edit this file.
file(GLOB _imsrg_unit_lists CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/unit/*/CMakeLists.txt")
foreach(_list IN LISTS _imsrg_unit_lists)
  get_filename_component(_dir "${_list}" DIRECTORY)
  add_subdirectory("${_dir}")
endforeach()

# Module layering (design/10-architecture.md section 2): the real tree, and the checker's own
# self-test against the deliberately bad fixture in tests/layering/fixtures/bad.
add_test(NAME layering.check
         COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/check_layering.py"
                 --repo-root "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}"
                 --module-deps "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/imsrg_module_deps.json")
add_test(NAME layering.self_test
         COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/check_layering.py"
                 --repo-root "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}" --self-test)
set_tests_properties(layering.check layering.self_test PROPERTIES LABELS unit TIMEOUT 60)
